title: The Question about Fasting and the Lord's Answer
description: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah. Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem-Melech with their men to entreat the Lord and ask the priests and prophets whether they should still mourn and fast in the fifth month as they had done for many years. The Lord answered through Zechariah and asked if they truly fasted and mourned for Him, or for themselves during those seventy years. He reminded them that these same words were proclaimed by the earlier prophets while Jerusalem was still inhabited and at peace.
